description: One report by slug: publisher and co-publishers, date, type, gated flag, summary, up to 5 key figures (value and unit exactly as written, each with page_ref), methodology note, source_url (the publisher's own page for the report) and the news / newsletters that covered it. Reports are published by the companies, investors, consultancies and analysts named as publisher; we link to the publisher's page and never host the file. Figures are quoted exactly as written, each with page_ref (a page number, or 'web' for an HTML page). gated = registration required at the publisher. Unknown arguments are rejected.
name: get_report
title: Get a report
